note: Non-secret capability & expected environment variable manifest. NEVER store secret values or hashes here — only variable NAMES, purposes, and whether the user expects them present in AI Studio Secrets. If any variable with expectedInAiStudio=true disappears, the AI must notify the user and ask to restore it.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Direct atomic GitHub commits/push, Actions CI status/logs, and Releases directly from AI Studio without routing through phone

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Direct Cloudflare Unified Hub Worker v6 deployment & SQLite Durable Object migration from AI Studio in ~1s

variables.name: CAVERN_BRIDGE_PAIR_SECRET
variables.purpose: Zero-knock instant E2E authentication with OmniAgent (S25 Ultra Termux + Android), Cavernize Live Bridge hot_exec, and 3-tier Flight Recorder

variables.name: CAVERN_RELAY_URL
variables.purpose: Cloudflare Unified Hub v6 relay endpoint for OmniAgent, Live Bridge, Swarm Bus, and 3-tier Flight Recorder

variables.name: CAVERN_ADMIN_KEY
variables.purpose: Optional admin header for Cloudflare relay management

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.purpose: Optional Cloudflare account ID (auto-discovered via /accounts if omitted)

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_NAME
variables.purpose: Optional Cloudflare Worker script name (auto-derived from CAVERN_RELAY_URL if omitted)
